messages:
Maria (CS): Hey team — customer AcmeCorp paused during onboarding and their 14d trial credits expired while SSO & billing migration were in progress. They say they couldn't complete org setup due to Okta provisioning delay. Asking for extension. Account: acct_9G7H2. 
Alex (Support): Thanks. Do we have a timestamp for when the org started onboarding and when the SSO issue was reported? 
Maria (CS): Onboarding start: 2026-02-20 14:10 UTC. Reported SSO error: 2026-02-23 09:05 UTC (user couldn't finish setup). Trial expired: 2026-02-25 00:00 UTC. 
Priya (Billing): Quick check — acct_9G7H2 shows trial grant applied on 2026-02-20 and auto-expired on 2026-02-25, no charges. Policy: trials are one-off and auto-expire; manual reinstatements require manager approval for >48h extensions. 
Maria (CS): Customer is requesting a 7-day extension so their SSO can finalize and they can complete integration tests. They supplied Okta logs showing provisioning delayed until 2026-02-24. 
Alex (Support): Can we do a short workaround while we escalate? Offer a temporary grant of $50 credits if policy allows. 
Priya (Billing): I can approve a small manual grant up to $100 if it's under our goodwill table. For anything larger we need Tim (Finance). 
Sam (Engineer): From a platform perspective, if we reapply a trial grant we need to ensure it doesn't collide with analytics or onboarding hooks. I can run a safe delta grant that doesn't retrigger onboarding flows. Command I use: 
```" + "
POST /internal/grants
Body: {"account":"acct_9G7H2","amount":50,"reason":"onboarding SSO delay - manual goodwill"}
```
Alex (Support): Maria pls confirm customer accepts $50. 
Maria (CS): Customer says yes, they'd take $50 to complete integration tests now; will follow up about policy docs for future reference. 
trial-bot: Automated check — account acct_9G7H2 has no active billing agreement; applying manual grant will create a provisional usage bucket. 
Priya (Billing): Proceeding to create the grant now, tagging Tim for visibility. 
Tim (Finance): I'm fine with $50 goodwill grants for onboarding cases. No PO needed. Please log under ticket CS-4821. 
Alex (Support): Grant applied. Ref #GRANT-20260225-01. Maria pls verify with customer. 
Maria (CS): Confirmed — customer received credits and ran their test suite successfully. They asked for a short written note on policy so they can explain to their procurement team. 
Priya (Billing): I'll draft a one-paragraph explanation: trial credits are single-use and time-limited; in edge cases we may provide manual goodwill grants for documented provisioning or platform outages; larger reinstatements require finance approval and are logged as exceptions. 
Sam (Engineer): FYI I added a small telemetry flag to avoid double-counting grant events in onboarding metrics. 
Maria (CS): Thanks everyone. Closing the thread. :tada:
